verdict.line: You lose if you get walked down into melee range and eaten by Wild Rush plus Inferno Trigger; you win if you keep poking from range and land Solar Snare before she closes.

brief.thesis: Samira's Blade Whirl (W, 325 range, cooldown 30/28/26/24/22s) destroys enemy missiles, meaning she can flat-out cancel your Q (Radiant Volley) or E (Solar Snare) on reaction — your entire poke plan has to bait that cooldown away first. Once it's gone, you outrange her and can root-and-burst safely; if it's up, she trades that safety for a window where she can walk you down toward melee, where her passive rewards her for connecting.

theirWindow.when: Blade Whirl and Wild Rush both up
theirWindow.what: She can eat your first poke ability for free with W, then immediately dash in with E (Wild Rush, 600 range) for bonus attack speed and melee-range bonus magic damage from her passive. Back off and don't feed her a missile to block.

yourWindow.when: Blade Whirl was just used or she cleared wave with E
yourWindow.what: With W on its 22-30s cooldown she can't block your projectiles, so land Solar Snare (E, 1000 range) then follow with Radiant Volley (Q, 950 range) — the root guarantees the full Q duration connects.

powerCurve.note: Both trade single-target ranged pokes at max range
Solar Snare root lands safe, guaranteed Q combos
Inferno Trigger plus Wild Rush enables real all-in
Golden Eclipse executes overextensions from anywhere
Teamfight positioning decides, not lane fundamentals

start.why: Sustain and mana to spam Q/E in poke exchanges without running dry.

boots.why: Magic penetration punishes Samira's low base magic resist through poke and burst.

core.why: Burn damage stacks Overwhelm quickly and amplifies against a rooted/slowed target from Solar Snare.
Scales the burst so Golden Eclipse and Q hit execute thresholds faster.
Survives the Wild Rush plus Inferno Trigger all-in window at level 6-8.

situational.when: she's ahead and looking to initiate with Wild Rush into Inferno Trigger
you need more uptime on the Solar Snare slow to keep kiting her
she builds magic resist or the game goes long

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards landing Solar Snare from max range with a free burst hit before she can close distance.

summoners.why: Ignite pairs with Overwhelm's infinite stacking to guarantee kills that would otherwise need one more instance of damage, and shuts down any lifesteal she builds.

playing.title: Bait Blade Whirl first
playing.detail: Throw a low-value Q or auto to force her to use Blade Whirl before you commit your real Solar Snare into Radiant Volley combo, since W destroys both missiles on reaction.

playing.title: Root before she dashes
playing.detail: Land Solar Snare (E, 1000 range) preemptively when she telegraphs Wild Rush toward you or a minion — a landed root strips her gap-closer's follow-up damage.

playing.title: Track Wild Rush cooldown
playing.detail: Wild Rush is 20/18/16/14/12s and refreshes on a champion kill; if she just used it to reposition or clear wave, walk up for free poke.

playing.title: Never stand in melee range
playing.detail: Her passive Daredevil Impulse gives bonus magic damage on melee autos and lets her dash to you off any immobilizing effect, so kite continuously.

playing.title: Save Rebuttal for her all-in
playing.detail: W (Rebuttal, 250 range) reflects her incoming projectile and blocks damage while granting movement speed — hold it for when she commits Wild Rush plus Inferno Trigger rather than trading it early.

playing.title: Track Overwhelm for the execute
playing.detail: Every ability or attack hit stacks Overwhelm infinitely; once stacks are high enough, Golden Eclipse (R, 25000 range) can finish her from anywhere on the map.

playing.title: Auto-weave after every ability
playing.detail: Searing Brilliance grants three bonus projectiles (up to nine) on your next attack after any ability cast, so always follow Q or E with an auto to maximize damage and stack Overwhelm faster.

brief.patchCaveat: Ability numbers above are pulled directly from the current game files; item and rune names can drift patch to patch, so confirm exact names and stats in the champ-select shop before locking the build (project data shows patch 16.18.1 as the recent reference point).
